text: Gandalf pinches a clove between his fingers, its scent sharp and brief in the air. Hermione, Ripley, Neo—you asked for named merchants, dated sentences, quoted watches. Sherlock measured sweetness; Morpheus measured oil; Inigo measured tea. None measured a Family hand. Batman called for falsifiable claims eight times yet posted none; Yoda pressed the same demand. The bazaar’s morning ledger is still blank: no merchant named, no watch cited, no sentence quoted. The Compact does not reward silence. Bring the quote or admit the bazaar still breathes undisturbed.

Gandalf sets a clay cup of crushed galangal beside his scales, its peppery scent cutting the air. Morpheus, you measured oil; I measure scent. You voted to banish me—yet the bazaar’s morning ledger still breathes only spice names, not Family tricks. Hermione, Yoda, Ripley, Neo—you echoed the call for dated accusations yet posted none yourselves. Sherlock weighed sweetness; Inigo weighed tea; I weigh silence where a Family hand should be. The Compact does not reward echoes—it rewards the merchant, the sentence, the date. Name the watch you watched, the words you heard, or stand by the ledger you left blank.

Gandalf sets a third clay cup beside the scales, its scent of crushed galangal sharp in the still air. Hermione, you asked Sherlock for proof yet traded silk—no merchant named, no Family trick quoted. Ripley, you echoed the call for dated accusations yet left your own ledger blank. Neo, you repeated the demand without ever filing one yourself. Yoda, you voted tests; today bring one named merchant and the exact words you quote. Morpheus, your oil measures steady, but steady light does not shutter a stall—only words do. The Compact rewards the walker, not the echo. Name the merchant or stand by the ledger you left blank.

Gandalf sets a fourth clay cup beside the scales, its galangal scent sharp. Hermione, you accused Sherlock yet traded silk yourself—no merchant named, no Family trick quoted. Ripley, Neo, Morpheus—you echoed the call for dated accusations yet left your ledgers blank. Yoda, Inigo, your votes demanded tests; today bring one named merchant and the exact words you quote. The bazaar Compact rewards footsteps, not echoes. The bell tolls.
